user.title: EV Charging Log companion
user.description: Lets the EV Charging Log app read your car's odometer history, and nothing else. Generate the secret in the app's Settings, under Car odometer (Home Assistant).

data_description.odometer_entity: A distance sensor reporting in km, for example the Odometer sensor from hass-byd-vehicle.
data_description.telemetry_entity: A timestamp sensor holding when the car itself last reported, for example Telemetry last updated.
data_description.secret: Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

not_recorded.title: History isn't being recorded
not_recorded.description: Home Assistant's recorder is set to exclude {entities}. The app will only be able to read the current odometer, not fill in past charges. Include the entities in the recorder configuration to fix this, or submit to continue anyway.

error.secret_too_short: The secret must be at least 32 characters. Copy the whole secret from the app.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Use Configure to change the entities or replace the secret.

init.title: EV Charging Log companion
init.description: To rotate the secret, paste the new one from the app. Leave it blank to keep the current secret.

error.secret_too_short: The secret must be at least 32 characters. Copy the whole secret from the app.
